angle_en: Manmana bhava: the mind Krishna asks for
angle_hi: मन्मना भव: मन जो कृष्ण मांगते हैं

en.intro: Krishna now offers the simplest path. Listen for the instruction to fix the mind on Him.
en.notice: The key phrase is manmana bhava, with mind on me. Krishna asks for nothing but a focused mind, and in return promises that you will come to me alone.
en.next: He seals this with his reason: you are dear to me.
en.meaning: Fix your mind on me, become my devotee, worship me, and bow to me. You will come to me; I promise you this truly, because you are dear to me.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अब सबसे सरल मार्ग देते हैं। ध्यान से सुनिए, वे अर्जुन से क्या मांगते हैं।
hi.meaning: कृष्ण कहते हैं, तू मेरा भक्त हो जा, मेरेमें मनवाला हो जा, मेरा पूजन करनेवाला हो जा और मेरेको नमस्कार कर । ऐसा करनेसे तू मेरेको ही प्राप्त हो जायगा यह मैं तेरे सामने सत्य प्रतिज्ञा करता हूँ क्योंकि तू मेरा अत्यन्त प्रिय है ॥
hi.notice: मुख्य बात है मन्मना भव, यानी मेरेमें मनवाला हो जा। कृष्ण केवल एक ही बात मांगते हैं, अपना मन, और इसके बदले वे प्रतिज्ञा करते हैं कि तू केवल मेरे पास ही आएगा।
hi.next: वे इस वादे की वजह बताते हैं कि तू मेरा बहुत प्रिय है।

en.intro: Krishna now offers the simplest path. Listen for the instruction to fix the mind on Him.
en.body: Fix your mind on me, become my devotee, worship me, and bow to me. You will come to me; I promise you this truly, because you are dear to me. He seals this with his reason: you are dear to me.
